title: Clinical and Biological Correlates of Resistance and Relapse After CD19-Directed CAR T-Cell Therapy in Large B-Cell Lymphoma: A Structured Narrative Review.
snippet: CD19-directed chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy has transformed the treatment of relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma (r/r LBCL), yet primary resistance and relapse remain common. We evaluated how recent clinical and translational evidence refines established resistance frameworks and which knowledge gaps prevent the relative contribution....
